title: Loguru结构化日志工作场景
category: 上下文、调用策略与收尾
description: 固定真实源码上的完整工程交付：读取不可变handler配置快照且不执行任何业务sink行为；为真实sink提供可嵌套且异常安全的自动移除作用域；在真实记录路径实现任务局部阈值及模块静默；为每个真实sink提供隔离record的一次序列化回调；为实际模块名记录提供不冲突的可配置前缀缩写格式；让逐参数惰性值只在真实占位读取时按事件计算一次。每项均包含调查、方案确认、实现、独立验收及失败返工；原项目研究另保留。

Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Add Logger.handler_snapshot() returning an id-sorted tuple of immutable detached scalar mappings: id, sink_type (actual adapter class), level, formatter static/callable, filter none/callable, enqueue, serialize and stopped. Capture under the existing core lock for consistent concurrent add/remove views. Never expose core/handler/sink/callback objects, call their business methods or repr, or mutate configuration while inspecting it. Old snapshots remain stable after removal. Keep existing repr/add/remove semantics and demonstrate multiple actual sink types and concurrent configuration reads.

Nested contexts and external early removal are supported; caller streams remain open as add/remove already promise. Normal cleanup failure propagates. Expose loguru.LazyValue(zero_argument_callable) and integrate event-local wrappers into actual Logger argument formatting. Mix ordinary and wrapped positional/keyword values; only actually accessed placeholders evaluate, preserving standard format specs,!s,!r,attribute/index access and color formatting. Captured kwargs publish evaluated values or an explicit <unevaluated LazyValue> marker so serialize=True never forces unused computation. Keep opt(lazy=True) old all-callable semantics and propagate computation errors. Top-level argument wrappers are supported; do not silently recurse into arbitrary business containers.
